notes.text: The sheet bears the author's dark number 27 at the upper left and a separate pale foliation 62 in another hand at the lower left. There are 25 principal body baselines, including the cancelled opening and the cancelled short line below d); the insertions and two five-line margins are inventoried separately.

The manuscript cancels its opening draft c) with oblique crossing and enclosing strokes. Its final les-like group and semicolon remain transcribed. In a), est tot with raised t is inserted above the cancelled (fini) est area. The following cancelled preimage expression has no written closing parenthesis after the right brace.

The manuscript's a)–d) list uses the words ordonné, propre, transversale and transversal. The preimage expression in b) has a visible diagonal across its two-bar relation sign; both candidate readings remain in place. These observations record the manuscript, and no proof check is claimed.

In c), la famille attaches before a live des/les word; the first g of germes is overwritten. The body est before une famille remains live. The inserted words and cancelled bordants and transversaux are retained individually, including the manuscript's resulting wording. The first d) map label and second target superscript remain open.

The author gives three numbered Cas headings. The upper margin contains the unresolved récollection/récollement and ends with three points. The lower margin says c'est sans doute conséquence de la conjonction des deux conditions 1°), 2°); that doubt belongs to the author and is preserved without a supplied final stop.

The last element arrow has a visible head and no initial bar; its three relation signs have curved arms. Earlier plain horizontal shafts retain their visible form. The second case ends with two vertically separated dots. Its initial Sigma is overwritten, without a securely identifiable underlying glyph.

The composite lower audit region begins at sont finis) and includes every later body line, both margins, all interlinear changes and the pale foliation. It keeps interleaved slanted writing together so that no complete insertion is quoted from a rectangle that clips it. The 32 individual evidence crops retain their original pixel coordinates; the two margins are rotated only in the viewing crops.
